newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mixed.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices remained mixed Monday, starting the week off in subdued activity, dealers said.

"It is Monday and nobody seems to care," a northeastern dealer said. He noted a temporary little push in Buffalo prices."But I would expect this not to continue on the firm side unless we lose some (flour mill) run time," he said.
He added cold weather in the U.S. Northeast could still be a factor, but so far, he did not see any increases in demand for the near term. "I would look for the market to stay pretty calm," he said.
